briefings.title: Democratizing Security for the Agentic Web with Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups
briefings.tldr: As the agentic web drives an exponential surge in AI-powered security vulnerabilities and shifts the attacker landscape toward automated high school actors, Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht predicts that engineering teams will spend the next 18 months heavily prioritizing security and zero-trust infrastructure to patch 70 years of legacy software.
